capabilities: Show file and recursive folder sizes in the File Explorer
Highlight large files and folders with configurable thresholds
Open a ranking view of the largest files, note groups, and folders
Calculate a note's group size from the note plus its directly linked attachments
Toggle size labels in MAKE.md Navigator when MAKE.md is enabled
extras: Desktop only, because it depends on Obsidian desktop File Explorer DOM structures; the code was AI-generated and the author asks users to review it carefully; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: adds size labels to Obsidian's File Explorer and provides a ranking view for large files
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer does not show how much space files and folders take, making it hard to find what is filling up a vault.

relations.evidence: Optional MAKE.md Navigator support when MAKE.md is enabled.

summary: Desktop plugin that shows file and recursive folder sizes in the File Explorer and ranks the largest files, note groups, and folders.
